data.title: Iran asserts control over Strait of Hormuz, warns Gulf states over US deal | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Tehran reasserted its claim over the Strait of Hormuz and warned Gulf states after a joint US-Gulf statement rejected Iranian toll demands, while reports said tankers were turned back by the IRGC.
data.keywords: Iran,United States,Donald Trump,Marco Rubio,Oman,strait of hormuz,Gulf States,US-Iran deal
